sources.title: Ministry of Legal Affairs, Laws of Guyana, Volume 6: Public Holidays Act, Chapter 19:07 (L.R.O. 1/2012)
sources.said: 3. (1) The following days shall be public holidays namely— every Sunday; the first week-day of January; Republic Day, that is to say such day in each year as shall, by notice published in the Gazette, be appointed for the purpose by the Minister responsible for public holidays; Good Friday; Easter Monday; Labour Day, that is to say, the 1st May, or, if that day is a Sunday, the following day; Commonwealth Day, that is to say the first Monday in August; Christmas Day, or, if that day is a Sunday, the following day; the 26th December, or if that day is a Sunday, the following day, unless Christmas Day falls on a Sunday, and then the Tuesday following Christmas Day; Phagwah Day, or, if that day is a Sunday, the following day; Deepavali Day, or, if that day is a Sunday, the following day; Eid-Ul-Azha Day, or, if that day is a Sunday, the following day; Youman Nabi Day, or, if that day is a Sunday, the following day. ... 6. The Minister may by notification in the Gazette appoint any day to be observed as a public holiday in addition to or in substitution for any day mentioned in section 3
